notablePrerequisites: You have two nonartifact land cards in hand.
easyPrerequisites: You have a mana-producing land on the battlefield or in your hand.
description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two nonartifact lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Cloudstone Curio trigger twice.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a mana-producing land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 3 for the other Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
